app.title: Gemini 4 Argon
app.author: 737max
app.description: Gemini 4 Argon is a large language model released by DeepMind, offering multimodal capabilities and advanced reasoning.
proposed_tests: Download the model checkpoint (if available) and load with HuggingFace Transformers
Run a simple prompt and verify response structure
Measure inference latency for a 128-token prompt
Check GPU memory usage and compare against a baseline model
